title: PM Koretskyi orders faster repairs to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge
summary: The Cabinet of Ministers has instructed the Ministry for Recovery, Infrastructure and Transport to speed up repairs to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge, which was damaged in a Russian missile attack overnight on October 27.

title: Soldier who held position alone for 491 days nominated for Hero of Ukraine title
summary: The Verkhovna Rada supported an appeal to the President to award the title of Hero of Ukraine to serviceman Kostiantyn Vlasenko, who held a combat position in the Kupiansk sector for 491 days and was evacuated after suffering severe injuries during a unique aerial evacuation operation.

title: Azov fighter sentenced to 29 years by Russia returns from captivity
summary: As a result of the prisoner exchange on October 23, Azov soldier Taras Zvarychuk returned from Russian captivity; the occupiers had sentenced him to 29 years in prison “for terrorism.”

title: Russian airstrike on Sloviansk city center injures one person
summary: On the evening of October 27, Russian troops carried out an airstrike on the center of Sloviansk; a woman was injured, and a school building was destroyed.

title: Zelensky: Ukraine receives average of just 12 Patriot missiles per month this year
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that this year, Ukraine is receiving an average of only 12 missiles per month for its Patriot systems.

title: War update: Over 190 clashes on front lines in past day, most Russian attacks on Pokrovsk axis
summary: A total of 191 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on October 27.

title: Air defenses neutralize 71 Russian drones overnight
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces have neutralized 71 Russian drones since the evening of October 27.

title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,510 over past day
summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 28, 2026, have reached approximately 1,583,350 personnel, including 1,510 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia region 846 times over past 24 hours, two injured
summary: Russian troops launched 846 attacks on 41 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours. Two people were injured in enemy attacks on the Zaporizhzhia district.

title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Kharkiv rises to five
summary: The number of people injured in a Russian attack on Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district has risen to five, including a child.

title: 'Cognitive erosion' has become a new target of disinformation – expert
summary: The strategy behind modern disinformation operations has undergone significant changes. With the development of artificial intelligence technologies, hostile actors are increasingly abandoning attempts to persuade audiences of anything in favor of what is known as "cognitive erosion."

title: Norway extradites banker suspected of stealing over UAH 1M from customers' accounts to Ukraine
summary: A former bank employee from Ukraine's Ternopil region, suspected of misappropriating customers' funds and wanted internationally, has been extradited from Norway to Ukraine.

title: Fire reported at steelworks in Russia's Lipetsk after attack – social media
summary: The Russian city of Lipetsk was targeted by jet-powered projectiles, and a fire reportedly broke out near the Novolipetsk steel mill (NLMK), according to preliminary information.

title: Kyiv to allocate UAH 1 bn for water crossings over the Dnipro, Klitschko says
summary: Additional technical solutions are being developed to preserve the structural integrity of bridges across the Dnipro River amid attacks on critical infrastructure in the capital.

title: Norway allocates nearly $54M in energy support for Ukraine
summary: The Norwegian government announced on Tuesday, October 27, that it would provide 500 million kroner (nearly $54 million) in energy support for Ukraine ahead of winter.

title: Ukrposhta cuts network to 7,211 branches over three years, Lubinets says
summary: Dmytro Lubinets, the Verkhovna Rada Commissioner for Human Rights, announced a reduction in the Ukrposhta network from 10,000 to 7,211 branches and provided the company with recommendations on tracking mobile branches and ensuring citizens’ access to postal services.

title: Zelensky says he does not know when he could meet with Putin
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said he does not know when a meeting between the leaders of Ukraine, the United States and Russia might take place.

title: Zelensky: Ukraine hopes to hold trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi by Nov 10
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said Ukraine is waiting for the United States to set a date for trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi, which he hopes will take place by November 10.

title: Russian forces attack Ukrnafta gas station in Dnipropetrovsk region
summary: A customer leaving a gas station in the Dnipropetrovsk region was injured in a drone strike.

title: Ukraine may return to nighttime lights-out measures due to new Russian drones – 'Flash'
summary: If Russia begins mass deployment of the Susanin optical navigation module on the Geran-5 jet-powered attack drone and other UAVs at night, Ukraine may have to reconsider measures to limit nighttime lighting.

title: Belarus continues to relay signals to Russian drones, troop numbers near border unchanged – Demchenko
summary: As of today, there has been no buildup of Russian forces in Belarus, but signal repeaters that support Russian drones attacking Ukraine continue to operate there.

title: Britain to provide Ukraine with GBP 10B over three years – Zelensky
summary: Britain will provide Ukraine with GBP 10 billion over three years, including GBP 7 billion in economic support and GBP 3 billion for weapons.

title: Ukrainian, Russian forces observing ceasefire in Oleshky – Lubinets
summary: Life in Kherson has picked up following the ceasefire in the area of Oleshky.

title: Ukrainian forces deny Russian claims of capturing Barylivka in Sumy region
summary: The village of Barylivka in the Myropillia community remains under the control of Ukraine's Defense Forces.

title: Russian forces strike Kharkiv, killing one and injuring three
summary: Russian forces have struck Kharkiv’s Osnovianskyi district, killing one person and injuring three others.

title: Russian marketplace Ozon estimates losses from drone attacks on warehouses at over 30 billion rubles
summary: Russian online marketplace Ozon has estimated its losses from drone attacks on its logistics facilities at 30.1 billion rubles.

title: Zelensky arrives in the Netherlands
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in the Netherlands for an official visit.

title: Three Russian air defense assets hit over past 24 hours, General Staff says
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck three Russian air defense assets on Russian territory on October 27 and overnight into October 28. The targets included a Tor surface-to-air missile system, a radar station, and an electronic warfare system.

title: Ukraine’s indigenous ballistic missiles could put Russia’s best-defended targets at risk, Turkish expert says
summary: Ukraine’s development and use of its own ballistic missiles will pose a greater challenge to Russia by making some of its best-protected targets vulnerable.

title: 2027 State Budget draft approved in first reading
summary: The Verkhovna Rada has approved the draft law on Ukraine’s 2027 state budget in the first reading, with 239 lawmakers voting in favor.

title: Netherlands to provide Ukraine with €1.2B in non-military aid over three years
summary: The Dutch government will provide Ukraine with €1.2 billion in non-military assistance over the next three years. The funding will primarily support the energy and water supply sectors, Ukraine’s recovery and reconstruction, and cooperation between Ukrainian and Dutch businesses.

title: Russian forces step up assaults on Huliaipole axis, National Guard says
summary: Russian forces have stepped up assaults on the Huliaipole axis in recent days. Meanwhile, the highest number of combat engagements has been reported on the Pokrovsk axis, with heavy fighting also reported on the Ocheretyne and Kostiantynivka axes.

title: 16 Suspects detained in major stolen drones scheme
summary: Law enforcement officials have uncovered a large-scale scheme in which drones were allegedly stolen from military units, had their markings altered, and were resold to the military as new, according to investigators.

title: Ukrainian MP elected president of OSCE Parliamentary Assembly
summary: Mykyta Poturaiev, Chair of the Verkhovna Rada Committee on Humanitarian and Information Policy, has been elected president of the OSCE Parliamentary Assembly.

title: Ukraine has found a way to respond to Russian attacks on data centers, Zelensky says
summary: Ukraine has found a way to respond to Russian attacks on data centers and cyberspace, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

title: Trump says Zelensky and Putin will meet “very soon”
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump stated that a meeting between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Russian leader Vladimir Putin is expected to take place soon.

title: Zelensky: All forms of diplomacy must be used to defend Ukraine
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky states that all forms of diplomacy must be used to defend Ukraine.

title: Zelensky: Russia appears serious about Abu Dhabi meeting
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that following the conversation between European leaders and Russian President Putin, there is a sense that Russia is seriously committed to the meeting of the negotiating teams in Abu Dhabi, during which they plan to discuss the first steps toward de-escalation in the energy sector and at sea, as well as the exchange of prisoners.

title: Zelensky: Abu Dhabi meeting depends on U.S. side
summary: Whether the trilateral meeting of technical teams from Ukraine, Russia, and the U.S.—scheduled for early November—takes place depends on the American side.

title: Zelensky discusses Russian attacks and peace efforts with Dutch King
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed the lives of Ukrainians under constant Russian attacks and diplomatic efforts to achieve peace during a meeting with King Willem-Alexander of the Netherlands.

title: Russian strike sparks fire at factory in Dnipro
summary: In Dnipro, Russian forces struck an industrial facility, causing a fire to break out.

title: Turkey will keep straits closed to military ships while war against Ukraine continues
summary: Ankara will continue to enforce the current restrictions on the passage of military vessels through the Turkish straits in accordance with the Montreux Convention as long as the war against Ukraine continues.

title: Expert: Russia must accept reality of NATO’s 32 member countries
summary: Russia itself turned the issue of NATO expansion into a political one, and now it must acknowledge the new reality rather than make demands.

title: 1,746 children remain in mandatory evacuation zone in Donetsk region
summary: In the settlements of four territorial communities in Donetsk region, where the forced evacuation of families with children is underway, there remain 1,580 families raising 1,746 children.

title: Russian attacks target four districts in Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring five people
summary: The enemy attacked four districts more than 40 times using drones, artillery, and aerial bombs. Five people were injured. A child was among the victims.

title: Ukraine and Netherlands begin work on air defense project
summary: Ukraine and the Netherlands have begun work on an air defense project called Bliksem.

title: UN Human Rights Chief fears the worst for Ukrainian civilians in coming weeks and months
summary: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk said he sees too little empathy for Ukrainian civilians enduring Russian attacks.

title: Ukraine seeks European partners’ help with buses and generators, Bezgin says
summary: During meetings at the Council of Europe in Strasbourg, Ukrainian officials discussed communities’ urgent needs with European partners, including potential assistance with generators, school buses, school shelter upgrades, and additional municipal vehicles.

title: Ukraine seeks to present Carpathian strategy to EU by mid-2027, Bezgin says
summary: Ukraine aims to present a draft macro-regional strategy for the Carpathian region to European institutions in the first half of 2027, seeking to incorporate its priorities into the EU’s next budget period and secure funding for joint projects.

title: War update: 181 combat clashes on front line, Pokrovsk axis sees fiercest fighting
summary: A total of 181 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian troops were reported on the front line on October 28, including 38 on the Pokrovsk axis.

title: Sumy Region to expand underground schools
summary: Sumy Region is expanding its network of underground schools to provide safer learning environments. Thirteen underground schools are already operating, nine more are under construction, and project documentation has been prepared for another 14 facilities.

title: Russian strike damages veterinary center in Chernihiv, killing dog and injuring three women
summary: A Russian strike on Chernihiv damaged a municipal veterinary and sterilization center, killing one dog and injuring another dog and three cats.

title: Alliance response must be credible if Russia uses nuclear weapons, former NATO Director of Nuclear Policy says
summary: If Russia commits an act of aggression against NATO and crosses the nuclear threshold, the Alliance’s response must be “credible” and swift.
